exposure: INA-CBG's 2023 tariff system for caesarean sections
outcome: Average real cost of caesarean section
Difference between real cost and INA-CBG's tariff
cohort: The cohort consists of 30 patients who underwent caesarean section at Jogja Hospital between January and September 2023.
finding: The average real cost of caesarean sections was found to be significantly higher than the INA-CBG's 2023 tariff, particularly for certain INA-CBG's classes (Class 1 O-6-10-I, Class 3 O-6-10-I, and Class 3 O-6-10-II).
cross-section timing: Data collected retrospectively from January to September 2023
